notes: LCC preserves Hebrew's 3-clause structure (UNV merges clauses 2+3), making SN alignment more straightforward
他 and 他們 explicitly translate אֹתוֹ and אֹתָם respectively, so H0853 attaches without implicit braces; first clause's אֶת has no LCC equivalent → kept implicit
有 in 有男有女 is a Chinese grammatical particle with no Hebrew equivalent — left unannotated
就 (then/so) translates the waw-consecutive which is part of the verbal form — left unannotated as it has no independent SN
Could not verify exact FHL zero-padding from API; used standard 4-digit minimum (H0430, H0120, H0853) with naturally 4-digit numbers as-is (H6754, H1254, H2145, H5347)
